title: Add skills from skill_hub
placeholder: Paste a skill_hub skill page URL
help: Find a skill on the site, then paste its page URL or choose the downloaded .tar.gz file. Review the preview and acknowledge permissions before installing.
sizeHelp: Packages are limited to 20 MiB compressed, 64 MiB expanded and 10,000 entries.
catalogue: The default catalogue includes skills with the same names: {names}. You can enable the catalogue copies in the list instead of installing.
catalogueUnavailable: Could not read the default catalogue to check for skills with the same names.
snapshot: Package SHA-256: {digest}. Changes on the site are not fetched automatically after installation.
trust: I understand that skills from {source} run with the AI agent's full permissions and agree to install them.
